using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Akiiray.VRCAvatarLiteKitPlus;
using UnityEditor;
using UnityEditor.Animations;
using UnityEngine;
using VRC.SDK3.Avatars.Components;
using VRC.SDK3A.Editor;
using VRC.SDKBase.Editor;
using VRC.Core;
using P = VRC.SDK3.Avatars.ScriptableObjects.VRCExpressionParameters;
using Object = UnityEngine.Object;

public static class LiteKitSdkCheck
{
    private const string Compressor = "[LiteKit Parameter Compressor] ";
    private const string IndexName = "LiteKit_PC_Sync_Index";
    private const string LayerName = "LiteKit Parameter Compressor [4ED03D94]";
    private const string Cases = "ABCD";

    public static async void Run()
    {
        VRCSdkControlPanel panel = null;
        var exitCode = 1;
        try
        {
            panel = ScriptableObject.CreateInstance<VRCSdkControlPanel>();
            if (!VRCSdkControlPanel.TryGetBuilder<IVRCSdkAvatarBuilderApi>(out var builder))
                throw new InvalidOperationException("SDK Build API unavailable");

            foreach (var id in Cases)
            {
                try
                {
                    await RunCase(builder, id);
                }
                catch (Exception error)
                {
                    throw new InvalidOperationException($"SDK Builder case {id} failed", error);
                }
                Debug.Log($"LITEKIT_SDK_PASS {id}");
            }
            exitCode = 0;
        }
        catch (Exception error)
        {
            Debug.LogException(error);
        }
        finally
        {
            try
            {
                if (panel != null) Object.DestroyImmediate(panel);
            }
            catch (Exception error)
            {
                Debug.LogException(error);
                exitCode = 1;
            }

            if (exitCode == 0) Debug.Log($"LITEKIT_SDK_PASS {Cases.Length}");
            EditorApplication.Exit(exitCode);
        }
    }

    private static async Task RunCase(IVRCSdkAvatarBuilderApi builder, char id)
    {
        var folderName = "SDK_" + Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N");
        var folder = "Assets/" + folderName;
        GameObject root = null;
        GameObject instance = null;
        try
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(AssetDatabase.CreateFolder("Assets", folderName)))
                throw new IOException($"Could not create fixture folder {folder}");
            root = new GameObject("LiteKitSDK_" + id);
            root.AddComponent<Animator>();
            root.AddComponent<PipelineManager>();
            root.AddComponent<LiteKitParameterCompressor>();
            var d = root.GetComponent<VRCAvatarDescriptor>();
            var fxPath = folder + "/FX.controller";
            var expressionPath = folder + "/Parameters.asset";
            var prefabPath = folder + "/Avatar.prefab";
            var fx = AnimatorController.CreateAnimatorControllerAtPath(fxPath);
            if (id == 'C') fx.AddLayer(LayerName);
            var parameters = ScriptableObject.CreateInstance<P>();
            parameters.parameters = id == 'D'
                ? new[] {new P.Parameter {name="Flag", valueType=P.ValueType.Bool, networkSynced=true}}
                : Enumerable.Range(0, 6).Select(i => new P.Parameter {
                    name="Value" + i, valueType=i < 3 ? P.ValueType.Float : P.ValueType.Int, networkSynced=true
                }).ToArray();
            if (id == 'B')
                parameters.parameters = parameters.parameters.Append(new P.Parameter {
                    name=IndexName, valueType=P.ValueType.Int, networkSynced=true
                }).ToArray();
            AssetDatabase.CreateAsset(parameters, expressionPath);
            d.customExpressions = true;
            var menu = ScriptableObject.CreateInstance<VRC.SDK3.Avatars.ScriptableObjects.VRCExpressionsMenu>();
            AssetDatabase.CreateAsset(menu, folder + "/Menu.asset");
            d.expressionsMenu = menu;
            d.expressionParameters = parameters;
            d.customizeAnimationLayers = true;
            d.baseAnimationLayers = new[] {new VRCAvatarDescriptor.CustomAnimLayer
                {type=VRCAvatarDescriptor.AnimLayerType.FX, animatorController=fx}};
            var prefab = PrefabUtility.SaveAsPrefabAsset(root, prefabPath);
            AssetDatabase.SaveAssets();
            var paths = new[] {fxPath, expressionPath, prefabPath};
            var bytes = paths.Select(File.ReadAllBytes).ToArray();
            var fxLayers = fx.layers.Select(x => x.name).ToArray();
            var source = EditorJsonUtility.ToJson(parameters);
            instance = (GameObject)PrefabUtility.InstantiatePrefab(prefab);
            Object.DestroyImmediate(root);
            root = null;
            var (bundle, error, logs) = await Build(builder, instance);
            AssetDatabase.SaveAssets();
            Assert(paths.Select((path, i) => File.ReadAllBytes(path).SequenceEqual(bytes[i])).All(equal => equal)
                && source == EditorJsonUtility.ToJson(parameters)
                && fxLayers.SequenceEqual(fx.layers.Select(layer => layer.name)),
                "Source Prefab, FX or Expression Parameters changed");

            ValidateResult(id, bundle, error, logs);
            if (id == 'C')
                Assert(fx.layers.Any(layer => layer.name == LayerName), $"Source FX lost '{LayerName}'");
        }
        finally
        {
            if (instance != null) Object.DestroyImmediate(instance);
            if (root != null) Object.DestroyImmediate(root);
            if (AssetDatabase.IsValidFolder(folder) && !AssetDatabase.DeleteAsset(folder))
                throw new IOException($"Could not remove fixture folder {folder}");
        }
    }

    private static async Task<(string Bundle, Exception Error, List<(LogType Type, string Message)> Logs)>
        Build(IVRCSdkAvatarBuilderApi builder, GameObject instance)
    {
        var logs = new List<(LogType Type, string Message)>();
        void Capture(string message, string stackTrace, LogType type) => logs.Add((type, message));

        using var timeoutCancellation = new CancellationTokenSource();
        Application.logMessageReceived += Capture;
        try
        {
            var build = builder.Build(instance);
            var timeout = Task.Delay(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(95), timeoutCancellation.Token);
            if (await Task.WhenAny(build, timeout) != build)
                throw new TimeoutException("SDK Build did not finish within 95 seconds");

            try { return (await build, null, logs); }
            catch (Exception error) { return (null, error, logs); }
        }
        finally
        {
            Application.logMessageReceived -= Capture;
            timeoutCancellation.Cancel();
        }
    }

    private static void ValidateResult(char id, string bundle, Exception error, List<(LogType Type, string Message)> logs)
    {
        if (id == 'A' || id == 'D')
        {
            if (error != null) throw new InvalidOperationException("Unexpected SDK Build exception", error);
            Assert(!string.IsNullOrEmpty(bundle) && File.Exists(bundle), $"SDK Build did not return an existing Bundle: {bundle}");
            if (id == 'A')
                Assert(logs.Any(log => log.Type == LogType.Log && log.Message == Compressor + "48 → 24 bits (-24)"),
                    "Missing LiteKit compression result (48 → 24 bits)");
            else
                Assert(logs.Any(log => log.Type == LogType.Log &&
                    (log.Message == Compressor + "圧縮対象の同期Float / Int Parameterはありません。" ||
                     log.Message == Compressor + "There are no eligible synchronized Float / Int parameters.")),
                    "Missing LiteKit no-target diagnostic");
            return;
        }

        Assert(error is BuilderException && string.IsNullOrEmpty(bundle),
            $"Expected SDK BuilderException with no Bundle; got {error?.ToString() ?? "no exception"}, Bundle: {bundle}");
        var japanese = id == 'B'
            ? $"「Parameters」で予約 Parameter 名「{IndexName}」が使用されています。"
            : $"「FX」に予約レイヤー「{LayerName}」が存在します。";
        var english = id == 'B'
            ? $"Reserved parameter name '{IndexName}' is used in 'Parameters'."
            : $"Reserved Animator layer '{LayerName}' already exists in 'FX'.";
        Assert(logs.Any(log => log.Type == LogType.Exception
            && log.Message.StartsWith("InvalidOperationException: " + Compressor.TrimEnd() + "\n", StringComparison.Ordinal)
            && log.Message.Split('\n').Skip(1).Any(line => line.TrimEnd('\r') == japanese || line.TrimEnd('\r') == english)),
            $"Missing specific LiteKit collision error: {english}");
        Assert(logs.Any(log => log.Message.Contains("Preprocess Callback Failed")
            && log.Message.Contains("'BuildFrameworkOptimizeHook' reported a failure")),
            "SDK did not report that the NDMF optimization callback aborted the build");
    }

    private static void Assert(bool condition, string message)
    {
        if (!condition) throw new InvalidOperationException(message);
    }
}
